p: My mind holds only what I think with God.
pe: as you give your mind to the ideas for the day again before you sleep
ideas: My mind holds only what I think with God.

idea: My mind holds only what I think with God.
ev: Five minutes with this thought will be enough to set the day along the lines which God appointed
Each hour of the day, bring to your mind the thought with which the day began, and spend a quiet moment with it. Then repeat the two ideas you practice for the day unhurriedly
